resources.string: Uses the system recognizer. No download, no key - quality depends on the manufacturer.
Fully offline through whisper.cpp, no Google language pack. Needs a one-time 82 MB model download.

Close to Whisper large-v3 accuracy, but fast on a phone: it reads the whole recording at once instead of in 30 s windows. 25 European languages, detected by itself, with punctuation. One-time 670 MB download, ~700 MB memory while in use.
Confidential computing in an enclave. Shows \"Enclave verified\" only once the attestation is confirmed.
Speaches, faster-whisper-server, LocalAI or whisper.cpp\'s server - anything with /v1/audio/transcriptions. http:// works for addresses in your own network.
Very fast and cheap (about $0.04 per hour of audio), no privacy guarantee.
Accurate, about $0.003 per minute of audio, no privacy guarantee.
a little more accurate · $0.11 per hour
Whisper tiny. Fastest and smallest, but only fair at German.
Whisper base, fine-tuned for short dictations. FUTO\'s pick for German.
Whisper small, fine-tuned. Noticeably more accurate, still quick on current phones.
The large OpenAI model, tuned to stop where your speech stops. As accurate as the stock large model, about three times faster on short dictations.

The previous large model: always works through a full 30 s, so even a short dictation waits several seconds. The tuned large-v3-turbo above is as accurate and about three times faster - switch and delete this one.
